headline: A Delhi-based maker of tyre flaps, tubes and 2/3-wheeler tyres for tyre companies (FY26 revenue Rs 130 cr, EBITDA margin 27%, PAT Rs 22.3 cr; JK Tyre 89% of Q1 FY27 revenue), priced at 22.6x FY26 earnings (27.1x after a depreciation-method change and one-offs) against a 20.5x peer median; fair value Rs 107 (Avoid) because working capital near 47% of revenue, debt and a return on capital close to its cost leave little free cash.
red_flags: FY26 depreciation only Rs 0.45 cr on a Rs 137 cr gross block after a WDV-to-straight-line switch (Rs 3.30 cr lower, p. 313); adjusted P/E 26.5x vs 22.0x reported
JK Tyre 59.6% of FY26 and 88.7% of Q1 FY27 revenue; second customer fell from 25.2% to 5.6% (pp. 22-23)
Working capital 47% of revenue; cumulative CFO 50% of PAT FY24-26 (pp. 68-71)
Loans of Rs 13.13 cr outstanding to promoters and their entities, without repayment terms (p. 82)
Band Rs 163-172; fair value Rs 88 / 107 / 128 vs Rs 172; issue repays Rs 45 cr of debt (p. 114)

strengths: Five plants in Uttarakhand, Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh; flap capacity 43.2 lakh units a year (pp. 129, 134)
Long relationship and agreement with JK Tyre, a top-3 Indian tyre maker (p. 23)
Operating history since 1985 in tyre flaps (p. 194)
New tube and 2/3-wheeler tyre plants already built (p. 134)
weaknesses: JK Tyre 88.7% of Q1 FY27 revenue (p. 22)
Net debt Rs 104 cr before the issue (pp. 68-69)
Accounting software without audit trail in FY26 (p. 352)
opportunities: Filling the new 2/3-wheeler tyre plant (37% utilised) and tube plant (p. 134)
Rubber recycling and solid-tyre plants from the issue (p. 114)
Indian tyre market growing about 7% a year (p. 166)
threats: Loss or cut of JK Tyre volumes
Natural rubber and crude-linked input prices (p. 378)
Tyre makers insourcing flaps and tubes
Shift to tubeless tyres reducing flap and tube demand

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the upper band of Rs 172 (as announced by the company and reported): Neutral value Rs 107 is 37.7% below the price and the Bull value Rs 128 is also below it (-25.4%), so the call is Avoid. At the Rs 163 floor the Neutral value is 34.3% below. It would read Neutral at about Rs 153 or below and Subscribe at about Rs 119 or below. No material issue under the Fund's rules: the promoter loans are disclosed in full and no issue proceeds go to promoters.
reference_note: Band Rs 163-172, lot 87 (company announcement as reported; RHP prints [●]). At Rs 172: 2.8617 crore post-offer shares, market cap Rs 492 cr; P/E 22.6x FY26 PAT to owners (27.1x on adjusted Rs 18.18 cr); company's own P/E 16.6x (pre-offer weighted shares); P/B 2.25x post-offer; EV/EBITDA 14.4x FY26.
